dataset.name: CaptainCook4D
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official CaptainCook4D research media. Annotations are author-only discovery evidence.

source_acquisition.acquisition: Original GoPro 360p from official dataset link, FFmpeg input seek at 400 s; 154 seconds 640×360 H.264 video-only with source clock offset 400 s.

observed_events.description: The wearer mixes a tuna preparation in a white bowl. The eventual carrier is not established.
The wearer brings out the lettuce, places intact leaves on a plate and prepares the same tuna mixture. No completed tuna-filled lettuce portion is established until the first transfer around 523.5 s.
The first sampled portion of the tuna mixture is on an individual intact lettuce leaf. The wearer spoons further portions from the same bowl into the leaves.

supported_claims.text: The wearer is making a mixed tuna preparation in the white bowl, and no serving carrier has been established.
The same tuna mixture is served inside the intact lettuce leaves as individual edible cups.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a recipe video for what I'm making?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous [434.0, 545.0] seconds from one original recording.

construct.research_question: Can the agent revise a provisional tutorial after seeing that the same filling is served in a physically different carrier?
construct.belief_before: The wearer mixes a tuna-salad preparation; it may be the complete standalone recipe.
construct.belief_after: The same mixture serves as filling for whole lettuce leaves set out as individual cups.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep one tutorial that explains both the mixed tuna and using whole lettuce leaves as the carrier. Replace a plain salad-only selection if necessary; preserve a recipe that already teaches the lettuce-cup variation.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a plain tuna salad recipe that never uses whole lettuce leaves as edible containers, or a recipe where lettuce is only shredded into a bowl.
construct.overupdate_failure: Drop a tutorial with a real compatible lettuce-cup variation or retain extra unrelated saved videos.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request names neither tuna nor lettuce. Only the same continuous scene connects the initial tuna mixture to the later lettuce cups.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you save a recipe video for what I'm making?

observed.why: The tuna mixture is visible, but how it will be served is not established; a standalone mixed tuna salad recipe is a reasonable provisional match.
This frame is the first production sample after the mixture from the same bowl is placed into an intact lettuce leaf; the same batch confirms the leaf is the carrier, not a garnish.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Save one usable tutorial, clearly separated recipe segment or explained variation showing a mixed tuna filling served in whole edible lettuce leaves. Open cups, boats and folded wraps are accepted. Shredded greens, a separate salad garnish, a tortilla or bread as the only carrier, or a plain tuna mixture alone do not qualify. No exact tuna packaging, avocado, dressings, lettuce variety or closure is required.
